sources.official: National Savings Pakistan (savings.gov.pk): official result files, draw date lists and number search. Primary source.
sources.pkprizebond: pkprizebond.com: historical full lists from January 2000 to October 2023, through an earlier database copy. Used to fill gaps, cleaned and checked.
sources.prizeinfo: prizeinfo.net: first and second prize records, draw numbers, cities and schedules. Used to corroborate.

method.1: Prize sections are read by their headings; amounts and counts come from each document.
method.2: A list is published only when its counts match the official prize table and no number repeats.
method.3: A draw is verified when an official file or two independent sources agree on the top prizes.
method.4: When sources disagree, the official number search decides; otherwise the draw is marked disputed.
